עצמות-כלים.notes: THE central pair of Gate 4 (שער עצמות וכלים = 'the Gate of Self and Vessels'). RENDERINGS: (1) the Emanator's / Ein Sof's / Creator's עצמות, INCLUDING the spreading sense → 'Self' (capitalised): עצמות המאציל = 'the [very] Self of the Emanator'; עצמותו = 'His Self'; העצמות המתפשט בתוך הכלים = 'the Self that spreads [forth] within the vessels'; עצם האלקות = 'the Self of divinity / of the Godhead'; עצם אחד = 'one Self'; העצם הפשוט = 'the simple Self'; האור העצמות = 'the light of the Self'; הספירות העצמיות = 'the Sefirot of the Self'; debate labels 'Self or vessels', 'the Sefirot that are Self', 'the Chesed which is the Self'. (2) a Sefirah's own עצמות/עצם → 'its own self' ('her own self' only under the pronoun rule); עצם הכתר / עצמות החכמה → 'Keter itself' / 'Chokhmah itself' or 'the very self of Chokhmah'. (3) עצמות/עצם הספירות → 'the Sefirot themselves'; עצמותם → 'their very selves'. (4) other things: עצמות השמש = 'the very self of the sun', עצם הנפש = 'the soul itself', עצם השפע = 'the effluence itself'. 'selfhood' is in reserve where an abstract noun is unavoidable. For adverbial בעצם / adjectival עצמי see עצם-מקרה ('intrinsic(ally)', 'in itself'). 'Essence' is NO LONGER used for this root — 'essence' = מהות. Transliteration gloss '[atzmut]' stands at 1:8:1 (first divine use) and 4:1:2 (the gate's defining question). CONSIDERED AND DECLINED: substance (impersonal/material; kept only for עצם as a philosophers' noun and the idiom 'in substance'), ipseity, being, existence (=מציאות), actuality (=פועל), presence (=שכינה, and it blurs the Gate-4 question), marrow (collides with מוֹחַ/מוֹחָא; and Gate 4's question and its resolution must share one noun). PRONOUNS (Avi agreed): Sefirot default 'it'; 'she/he' only where the passage casts the Sefirah in a gendered role; never by Hebrew grammatical gender. כלים = 'vessels'; כלי האומן = 'the vessels/instruments of the craftsman'. The dispute: are the Sefirot God's Self (R. David) or His vessels (Recanati)? Cordovero's synthesis: vessels within which the Self spreads. CAPITALISATION (Avi, 2026-10-07): 'Self' takes a capital ONLY where the self in question is the Emanator's / Ein Sof's own; any other self is lower-case ('its own self', 'the very self of the sun'). Title case in gate titles is fine. שֵׁם הָעֶצֶם = 'the Name of the self' in running text, lower-case: at 19:1:5 Cordovero denies that it names the Emanator's עצמות — it names the עצמות of the Sefirot (and plays on the grammarians' 'proper name'). NOT 'Godself'.
